claims: Rick Pitino is the head men's basketball coach at St. John's University.
Rick Pitino was hired on March 20, 2023.
Rick Pitino was hired as the 22nd coach in St. John's University men's basketball program history.
Rick Pitino is a Hall of Famer.
Rick Pitino has led the 2025-26 Red Storm to the Sweet 16.
Rick Pitino's staff includes Associate Head Coach Steve Masiello.
Rick Pitino's staff includes assistant coach Ricky Johns.
Rick Pitino's staff includes assistant coach Taliek Brown.
Rick Pitino's staff includes assistant coach Bob Walsh.
A St. John's University Athletics article states that Rick Pitino's staff features several coaches who previously worked with Pitino at Iona.
A USA Today article states that Pitino is a two-time NCAA National Champion.
A USA Today article states that Pitino has taken five different schools to the Sweet 16 over five decades.
A Facebook post states that Rick Pitino was named the 2025 BIG EAST Coach of the Year.
An Instagram post notes that Pitino led St. John's to the 2026 NCAA Tournament Sweet 16.
According to a St. John's University Athletics page, Joe Tartamella is the head coach for the St. John's women's basketball team.
